why_the_third_refusal_is_a_design_not_a_: improve.py:2829 states the intent in words: 'Existing sweep entries and report bytes are immutable; never re-sweep an already disposed finding.' The append-only design is deliberate, and appending a corrected duplicate does not help: validate.py:4265 iterates EVERY line, so the stale line keeps failing no matter what is appended after it.
what_is_actually_missing: there is no way to correct a sweep field whose truth has changed. reproduced is a MEASUREMENT recorded once, but it is validated per line forever, against a value no party is allowed to revise. A finding that did not reproduce when the sweep ran, and does reproduce now, has no exit.
the_minimum_engine_change: an amend verb on write_sweep_entry -- same journaled write, same base_hash conflict detection, same validate_sweep over the PROPOSED text, but keyed on the finding_ref instead of refusing it, and permitted only to change reproduced/ticket/disposition on a line that names a finding the amender re-measured, with the amender's measurement recorded in the entry
why_not_hand_edited: SWEEP.md is a project file, so a direct edit would silence the FAIL immediately. It would also overwrite a historical record with a value the sweeper never decided, which is the exact forgery the validator rule exists to prevent. The rule is right; the repair surface is missing.
operator_decision: either authorise the engine amend verb, or accept a permanent CURRENT_FAIL on the conformance gate, or authorise a one-time documented ledger correction with the measurement attached
